about: The match memory's moments (sim/match-memory.js): turning points, duels, let-offs, the chase's equation and the phases of the game. The first group for each is two sample lines a voice; the rest are the five scene moments' lines (plain, interesting, unorthodox). Add more freely.

bunnings: THAT MAY BE THE BALL WE TALK ABOUT LATER.
THE MATCH HAS JUST LEANED. QUITE A LOT.
lorry: THAT COULD BE THE TURNING POINT! WHAT A MOMENT!
EVERYTHING JUST CHANGED! {team} WILL FEEL THAT!
grog: THAT SHIFTS THE BALANCE. {team} WERE {before} PER CENT, NOW {after}.
ONE BALL, AND THE PLANS ALL CHANGE.

bunnings: THIS STAND OF {stand} HAS QUIETLY MOVED THE MATCH.
{stand} TOGETHER. THE GAME LOOKS DIFFERENT NOW.
lorry: {stand} RUNS TOGETHER! THEY'VE TURNED THIS AROUND!
WHAT A PARTNERSHIP! {stand} OFF {balls}!
grog: {stand} OFF {balls} BALLS. THE BOWLERS NEED A NEW IDEA.
THIS PAIR HAS CHANGED THE SHAPE OF THE GAME.

bunnings: {w} HAS BEATEN {b} {beaten} TIMES NOW.
{b} AND {w}. ONE OF THEM IS ENJOYING THIS MORE.
lorry: BEATEN AGAIN! {w} HAS {b} ON A STRING!
{beaten} TIMES {w} HAS GONE PAST THE EDGE!
grog: {w} HAS FOUND {b}'S WEAK SPOT. {beaten} PLAYS AND MISSES.
SAME LINE, SAME RESULT. {w} WILL KEEP GOING THERE.

bunnings: {b} HAS {runs} OFF {w} FROM {balls} BALLS.
{w} MAY BE SEEING {b} IN HIS SLEEP.
lorry: {runs} OFF {balls} AGAINST {w}! {b} OWNS HIM!
{b} JUST LOVES FACING {w}!
grog: {runs} FROM {balls}. {w} NEEDS A DIFFERENT PLAN.
TIME TO TAKE {w} OFF AGAINST {b}, I'D SAY.

bunnings: {w} HAS HIM AGAIN. THAT'S {times} TIMES.
{b} WON'T BE SENDING {w} A CARD.
lorry: HE'S GOT HIM AGAIN! {times} TIMES THIS MATCH!
{w} HAS {b}'S NUMBER!
grog: {times} TIMES NOW. {w} KNOWS EXACTLY WHERE TO BOWL.
SAME BOWLER, SAME BATTER, SAME ENDING.

bunnings: {dots} DOTS IN A ROW FROM {w} TO {b}.
{b} HASN'T SCORED OFF {w} IN A WHILE.
lorry: {dots} DOTS! {w} IS SQUEEZING HIM!
NOTHING DOING! {b} CAN'T GET {w} AWAY!
grog: {dots} DOTS. {w} IS BUILDING THE PRESSURE NICELY.
{b} NEEDS TO ROTATE THE STRIKE AGAINST {w}.

bunnings: {b} WAS ON {droppedOn} AT {letoff}. HE'S {nowOn} NOW.
{letoff} HAS COST {cost} RUNS SO FAR.
lorry: {cost} RUNS SINCE {letoff}! THAT'S HURTING!
{b} WAS ON {droppedOn}! NOW HE'S {nowOn}!
grog: {letoff} ON {droppedOn}. {cost} RUNS LATER, IT MATTERS.
THAT'S {cost} SINCE {letoff}. CHANCES COST.

bunnings: THE RATE HAS CLIMBED PAST {threshold} AN OVER.
{need} OFF {left}. THE ASKING RATE IS {rrr}.
lorry: OVER {threshold} AN OVER NOW! THIS IS GETTING TIGHT!
THEY NEED {rrr} AN OVER! COME ON!
grog: {rrr} AN OVER. THEY CAN'T WAIT MUCH LONGER.
PAST {threshold} AN OVER. SOMEONE HAS TO GO.

bunnings: {runs} AFTER {over} OVERS. {diff} AHEAD OF THE PACE.
AFTER {over}, {team} ARE ON TRACK.
lorry: {diff} AHEAD OF THE RATE AFTER {over}! LOVELY STUFF!
{team} ARE WELL IN THIS AFTER {over} OVERS!
grog: {over} OVERS GONE, {runs} ON THE BOARD. GOOD PLATFORM.
AHEAD BY {diff}. NOW DON'T THROW IT AWAY.

bunnings: {runs} AFTER {over} OVERS. {diff} BEHIND THE PACE.
AFTER {over}, {team} HAVE WORK TO DO.
lorry: {diff} BEHIND AFTER {over}! THEY'VE GOT TO GO!
{team} ARE FALLING BEHIND! {over} OVERS GONE!
grog: {diff} BEHIND AT {over} OVERS. TIME TO ACCELERATE.
{runs} AFTER {over}. THE BACK END WILL BE BUSY.

bunnings: A BOUNDARY AN OVER NOW, OR THEY FALL BEHIND.
{rrr} AN OVER. SINGLES WON'T DO IT.
lorry: THEY NEED A BOUNDARY EVERY OVER! EVERY ONE!
{rrr} AN OVER! FIND THE ROPE!
grog: AT {rrr}, THEY NEED A FOUR EVERY OVER. {overs} LEFT.
SINGLES AND A BOUNDARY AN OVER. THAT'S THE PLAN.

bunnings: A NEW BALL AFTER {overs} OVERS. SHINY.
THE NEW BALL. THE BATTERS WILL NOTICE.
lorry: NEW BALL! HERE COMES THE SWING!
THE NEW BALL'S HERE! LOOK OUT!
grog: NEW BALL. EXPECT THE QUICKS AND A SLIP OR TWO.
IT'LL COME ON QUICKER NOW. NEW BALL.

bunnings: THE OLD BALL HAS STARTED TO REVERSE.
{overs} OVERS OLD, AND GOING THE OTHER WAY.
lorry: IT'S REVERSING! THE OLD BALL IS TALKING!
REVERSE SWING! THIS COULD GET LIVELY!
grog: REVERSE SWING NOW. FULL AND STRAIGHT IS THE PLAN.
ONE SIDE ROUGH, ONE SIDE SHINY. IT'S REVERSING.

bunnings: THE PITCH HAS STARTED TO TURN.
SOME DUST ABOUT NOW. THE SPINNERS WILL SMILE.
lorry: IT'S TURNING NOW! SPINNERS' TIME!
LOOK AT THAT GRIP! THE PITCH IS BREAKING UP!
grog: THE SURFACE IS WEARING. SPIN FROM BOTH ENDS, I'D SAY.
IT'S TURNING. GET THE SPINNER ON.

bunnings: {runs} FOR {wkts} FROM THE POWERPLAY.
THE POWERPLAY ENDS. THE FIELD SPREADS.
lorry: {runs} FOR {wkts} IN THE POWERPLAY! WHAT A START!
POWERPLAY DONE! NOW IT GETS HARDER!
grog: {runs} FOR {wkts} AFTER {overs}. NOW FOR THE MIDDLE OVERS.
FIELDERS BACK. SINGLES ARE THE CURRENCY NOW.

bunnings: WE'RE INTO {light} NOW.
THE LIGHT HAS CHANGED. SO MIGHT THE CRICKET.
lorry: {light}! WHAT A SIGHT!
AND NOW {light}! LOVELY!
grog: {light}. THE BALL CAN DO MORE NOW.
A CHANGE OF LIGHT. HARDER TO PICK UP OFF THE HAND.

bunnings: THE LAST OVER BEFORE {brk}.
ONE MORE OVER, THEN {brk}.
lorry: LAST OVER BEFORE {brk}! DON'T GET OUT NOW!
ONE MORE BEFORE {brk}! HANG ON!
grog: LAST OVER BEFORE {brk}. A WICKET NOW WOULD BE GOLD.
BATTERS JUST WANT TO SEE THIS ONE OUT BEFORE {brk}.

bunnings.text: THAT'S THE MOMENT. {b} GONE, AND WITH HIM {team}'S GRIP.

bunnings: THE GAME HAS SHIFTED.

bunnings.text: A BIG WICKET. A VERY BIG WICKET.
TEN MINUTES AGO THAT LOOKED COMFORTABLE. NOT ANY MORE.

bunnings: THE SCOREBOARD SAYS {score}. IT DOESN'T TELL YOU THAT THE MATCH HAS TURNED.

bunnings.text: {w} HAS BEEN BUILDING TO THAT WICKET FOR THREE OVERS.

bunnings: YOU COULD HEAR THE CROWD CHANGE THEIR MINDS.
SOMEWHERE, A SCORER HAS UNDERLINED THAT BALL TWICE.
AND THE PENDULUM, WHICH HAD BEEN RESTING, SWINGS.
HISTORY TENDS TO REMEMBER THE HUNDRED. IT SHOULD REMEMBER THIS.
IF YOU WERE MAKING A CUP OF TEA, YOU MISSED THE MATCH.
MARVELLOUS. QUIETLY, COMPLETELY MARVELLOUS.

lorry.text: GOT HIM! THAT COULD BE THE MATCH!

lorry: MOMENTUM'S SWUNG, BIG TIME!

lorry.text: {w} HAS RIPPED THE HEART OUT OF THIS CHASE!

lorry: HUGE MOMENT, AND {team} KNOW IT!

lorry.text: THEY WERE CRUISING, NOW THEY'RE IN A WORLD OF TROUBLE!
ONE BALL, THE WHOLE TEST FLIPPED ON ITS HEAD!
THE DRESSING ROOM'S GONE VERY QUIET, I CAN TELL YOU!
THAT'S THE WICKET THEY'VE BEEN PRAYING FOR ALL SESSION!

lorry: SOMEBODY CHECK THE SEISMOGRAPH, THE GROUND JUST MOVED!

lorry.text: THAT'S NOT A WICKET, THAT'S A PLOT TWIST!

lorry: THEY'LL BE MAKING A MINI-SERIES ABOUT THAT BALL!
I JUST AGED TEN YEARS, AND I LOVED EVERY SECOND!
HOLD ONTO YOUR PIES, THIS MATCH HAS GONE MAD!

grog.text: SET BATTER'S OUT. THAT'S THE DAMAGE.
THAT'S THE WICKET THEY NEEDED.
LOSE HIM THERE AND THE TAIL'S EXPOSED.
TWO NEW BATTERS IN THE MIDDLE NOW. BOWL STRAIGHT, KEEP THE FIELD UP.
WIN THIS SESSION, WIN THE TEST. THEY JUST WON IT.
BOWLING SIDE'S OUT OF PLANS. CAPTAIN NEEDS SOMETHING NEW.
THEY GOT ONE WICKET AND TWO PLANS WORKED STRAIGHT AWAY.

grog: COACH IN THE ROOMS JUST CLOSED HIS LAPTOP.

grog.text: THAT WICKET'S WORTH FIFTY RUNS ON THE BOARD.

grog: I'D HAVE THAT BALL FRAMED FOR THE DRESSING ROOM.
WAKE THE TWELFTH MAN UP, IT'S ON NOW.

bunnings: {stand} TOGETHER. CONTROL HAS CHANGED HANDS.

bunnings.text: PARTNERSHIPS LIKE THIS ONE DON'T SHOW UP IN THE HIGHLIGHTS, BUT THEY DECIDE TESTS.

lorry: {stand} UP AND THEY'VE SNATCHED IT BACK!
THIS STAND HAS TAKEN THE GAME RIGHT OUT OF THE BOWLERS' HANDS!
grog: THIS STAND'S TAKEN THE GAME AWAY.
THEY'RE AHEAD NOW. NOBODY NOTICED.
THAT'S {stand} TOGETHER WITH NO FUSS, AND THAT'S WHAT HURTS THE BOWLERS.
NOBODY WILL NOTICE HOW THEY WON THIS UNTIL THEY WATCH IT BACK.

bunnings: BEATEN AGAIN. THAT'S {beaten} TIMES NOW.
{w} WILL ENJOY THAT.
{b} LOOKS AT {w} THE WAY MOST OF US LOOK AT A TAX RETURN.
A CONTEST WITHIN THE CONTEST, AND ONLY ONE MAN'S WINNING IT.
HE'S PLAYED AND MISSED {beaten} TIMES. HE HASN'T BEEN OUT YET.
{w} HAS BOWLED {balls} BALLS TO HIM. HE'S YET TO BE FORGIVEN.
THE BAT AND THE BALL HAVE NOW BEEN INTRODUCED {beaten} TIMES. NO CONTACT.
ONE SUSPECTS {w} DREAMS IN OUTSWINGERS TO {b}.
lorry: HE'S BEATEN HIM AGAIN!
WHAT A BATTLE THIS IS!
EVERY TIME {w} COMES ON, {b} GOES PALE!
BEATEN, BEATEN, BEATEN, HOW IS HE STILL IN?!
{b}'S BAT MIGHT AS WELL BE A BROOMSTICK AGAINST THIS BLOKE!
grog: CAN'T PICK THE ONE GOING AWAY.
BOWLER'S WINNING THAT BATTLE.
KEEP {w} ON. ONE MORE OVER AND HE'LL GET HIM.
CHANGE THE ANGLE, GO ROUND THE WICKET, HE'S GOT HIM THERE.
GIVE {b} A SIGHT SCREEN AND A BLINDFOLD, SAME RESULT.

bunnings: {runs} OFF {balls} FROM {w}.
SOME RIVALRIES ARE MADE IN HEAVEN. THIS ONE, AT THE TOP OF THE MARK.
lorry: {b} IS TREATING {w} LIKE A NET BOWLER!
{runs} OFF {balls}, HE'S TAKING HIM APART!
{b} HAS DECIDED THIS IS HIS BOWLER TO GO AFTER!
GET THESE TWO A BOXING RING!
grog: {w}'S GONE FOR {runs}. TAKE HIM OFF.
{b}'S DECIDED HE'S THE TARGET. SMART, ACTUALLY.

bunnings: TWICE IN THE MATCH NOW. {w} HAS HIS NUMBER.
SAME BOWLER, SAME BATTER, SAME RESULT.
THEY MIGHT EXCHANGE CHRISTMAS CARDS AFTER THIS. PERHAPS NOT.

lorry.text: GOT HIM IN BOTH INNINGS!
SECOND INNINGS, SAME TRAP, SAME RESULT, UNBELIEVABLE!

lorry: {w}'S GOT A VOODOO DOLL IN HIS POCKET, SURELY!
THIS FEUD'S GONNA OUTLIVE BOTH OF US!

grog.text: SAME DISMISSAL AS THE FIRST INNINGS.

grog: PUT {w} ON AT THE OTHER END TOO, I DON'T CARE.
HE'LL BE WATCHING THAT FOOTAGE AT THREE IN THE MORNING.
THAT'S NOT A DUEL, THAT'S AN OWNERSHIP ARRANGEMENT.
PAY {w} BY THE {b}.

bunnings: {dots} DOTS IN A ROW.
{b} IS SCORING OFF EVERYONE EXCEPT {w}.
lorry: {dots} DOTS AND THE CROWD'S RESTLESS!
SOMEBODY GIVE {b} A MAP, HE'S LOST!
grog: HE'S TIED DOWN. SOMEONE HAS TO BREAK THAT.
HE'S DONE NOTHING WITH THE FEET. HE'S FROZEN IN THE CREASE AGAINST THIS BLOKE.
{dots} DOTS MEANS HE'LL TRY SOMETHING SILLY NEXT BALL.

bunnings: THAT MISS HAS COST {cost}.
A REPRIEVE, WELL USED.
EXPENSIVE.

bunnings.text: {fielder} WILL BE REMINDED OF THAT ONE AT DINNER.
{cost} RUNS. THAT CATCH WOULD HAVE CHANGED EVERYTHING.
THE REVIEW THEY WASTED WOULD HAVE BEEN HANDY RIGHT ABOUT NOW.
A MISSED RUN-OUT ON {droppedOn}. THE STUMPS WERE VERY MUCH AVAILABLE.
EVERY RUN SINCE {droppedOn} BELONGS, IN A SENSE, TO {fielder}.
SOMEWHERE, {fielder} IS QUIETLY CALCULATING HIS SHARE OF THE HUNDRED.
ONE SHOULD NEVER DROP A MAN WHO IS ON {droppedOn}. OR ON ANYTHING.
THAT CATCH IS STILL UP THERE, IN A MANNER OF SPEAKING.
THE SCORERS OUGHT TO CREDIT {fielder} WITH AN ASSIST.

bunnings: LIFE IS SHORT. HIS SECOND ONE HAS BEEN RATHER LONG.

lorry.text: DROPPED ON {droppedOn}, NOW {nowOn}!
THAT'S {cost} RUNS OFF ONE SPILL!
RUBBING SALT IN IT NOW!
SHOULD'VE BEEN GONE AGES AGO!
GOT HIM FINALLY, {cost} TOO LATE!
{fielder}'S HIDING AT FINE LEG AND I DON'T BLAME HIM!
EVERY BOUNDARY NOW IS ANOTHER DAGGER!
THE WASTED REVIEW, OH, THEY'D KILL FOR IT NOW!
MISSED RUN-OUT, AND HE'S GONE ON TO {nowOn}!
SECOND LIFE AND HE'S PARTYING LIKE IT'S HIS BIRTHDAY!
SOMEONE SEND {fielder} A BUCKET AND SOME GLUE!
THAT DROPPED CATCH HAS ITS OWN FAN CLUB NOW!
HE'S ON HIS NINTH LIFE, HE'S A CAT WITH PADS ON!
{fielder}'S GONNA GET A BILL FOR {cost} RUNS IN THE MAIL!
I'D BUY THAT DROP A BEER, IT'S HAD A BIG DAY!

grog.text: CATCHES WIN MATCHES. THAT'S COST {cost}.
HIT THE STUMPS, MATE.
BURNED A REVIEW, NOTHING LEFT.

grog: SECOND CHANCES MAKE HUNDREDS.

grog.text: GONE FOR {nowOn}. SHOULD'VE BEEN {droppedOn}.

grog: YOU CAN'T GIVE A GOOD PLAYER LIVES. HE'LL MAKE YOU PAY EVERY TIME.

grog.text: THAT DROP'S THE DIFFERENCE IN THIS MATCH, I RECKON.
WASTED REVIEW EARLY, NOW THEY'VE GOT TO COP THE BAD DECISIONS.
FIELDING DRILLS TOMORROW AT SEVEN. GUARANTEED.

grog: {cost} RUNS. THAT'S A WHOLE SESSION'S WORK THROWN AWAY.

grog.text: PUT {fielder} AT SHORT LEG. MAKE HIM EARN IT BACK.
THAT CATCH WOULD'VE BEEN THE CHEAPEST {cost} RUNS THEY EVER SAVED.
SIGN HIM UP, HE'S THE BATTER'S BEST PLAYER.
I'VE SEEN SAFER HANDS ON A CLOCK.
FINE HIM A CARTON FOR EVERY TEN RUNS SINCE.

bunnings: THEY NEED {rrr} AN OVER.
{need} FROM {left}.
WICKETS IN HAND. THAT'S THE COMFORT.
THE RATE HAS CREPT UP WHILE NOBODY WAS LOOKING.
THE ARITHMETIC IS UNFORGIVING, AND IT NEVER TAKES A DAY OFF.
{need} RUNS. MERELY A MATTER OF MAKING THEM.
MATHEMATICS, IT TURNS OUT, IS A SPECTATOR SPORT.
lorry: OVER {rrr} AN OVER, IT'S TIGHT!

lorry.text: TWO A BALL!

lorry: {need} TO GET, CLOCK'S TICKING!
THE RATE'S CLIMBING LIKE A KITE IN A SOUTHERLY!
GET ME A CALCULATOR AND A DEFIBRILLATOR!
THE RUN RATE'S DOING THE MEXICAN WAVE!
{need} OFF {left}, I'VE SEEN GROCERY BILLS SCARIER!
grog: RATE'S AT {rrr}.
FIELD'S SPREAD. FIND THE TWOS, NOT THE SIXES.
RATE'S A LIAR. WICKETS IN HAND DECIDE THIS.

bunnings: AHEAD OF THE RATE.
lorry: WELL AHEAD OF THE RATE!
THIS CHASE IS ALIVE, FOLKS!
THEY'RE {diff} AHEAD OF PAR AND LOVING IT!
RUN A BALL AND THEY'RE IN CONTROL, JUST KEEP GOING!
grog: AHEAD. DON'T LOSE WICKETS.
RUN A BALL'S FINE WITH WICKETS IN HAND. DON'T PANIC.
AHEAD OF THE RATE, SO BOWL TIGHT AND LET THEM MAKE THE MISTAKE.

bunnings: BEHIND THE RATE.
THE SCOREBOARD IS NOT THEIR FRIEND AT THE MOMENT.
{diff} BEHIND WHERE THEY'D LIKE TO BE. NOT FATAL, BUT NOT IDEAL.
ONE COULD SAY THE CHASE IS ON. ONE COULD ALSO SAY IT'S LEAVING.
lorry: SOMEBODY TELL THE BATTERS THE BUS LEAVES SOON!
grog: {diff} BEHIND PAR.
DOTS ARE KILLING THEM.
THEY'VE LET IT DRIFT. SOMEONE HAS TO TAKE A RISK NOW.
I'D SEND THE TAILENDER IN TO HIT, HONESTLY.

grog.text: MAKE IT A T20 FOR FIVE OVERS AND SEE WHAT HAPPENS.

bunnings: A BOUNDARY AN OVER, NOW.
SINGLES ARE NO LONGER ENOUGH.
SOMEWHERE A CALCULATOR IS GETTING VERY WARM.
lorry: SINGLES WON'T DO IT!
FOURS NEEDED EVERY OVER, CAN THEY DO IT?!
STRAP IN, THE EQUATION'S JUST PUT THE BOOT DOWN!
grog: NEED A BOUNDARY AN OVER.
ONE BIG OVER FIXES ALL THIS. PICK YOUR BOWLER.
CHUCK THE BOWLING PLANS OUT, IT'S A SLOG NOW.
SOMEBODY'S GOTTA HIT ONE INTO THE CAR PARK.

bunnings: NEW BALL TAKEN.
A FRESH BALL, AND A FRESH SET OF PROBLEMS FOR THE BATTERS.
lorry: NEW BALL, LOOK OUT!
SHINY NEW CHERRY AND THE QUICKS ARE LICKING THEIR LIPS!
grog: NEW BALL, QUICKS ON.
NEW BALL, ATTACK THE STUMPS, TWO SLIPS AND A GULLY.

bunnings: THAT'S REVERSING.
THE ROUGH SIDE'S STARTING TO WORK. OLD-BALL SKILLS NOW.
THE BALL HAS GONE SOFT. RATHER LIKE THE BATTING.
A REVERSE-SWINGING BALL DOES WHAT IT LIKES. MOST UNSPORTING.
lorry: REVERSE SWING!
IT'S GOING THE WRONG WAY, THE BATTERS CAN'T READ IT!
THAT BALL'S GONE ROGUE!
grog: REVERSE IS HERE.
REVERSE IS HERE. PITCH IT UP, TARGET THE PADS.
REVERSE MEANS THE BATTERS CAN'T TELL WHICH WAY IT'LL GO. USE IT.

bunnings: TURNING NOW.
THE PITCH IS STARTING TO TURN. THE SPINNER LOOKS INTERESTED.
THE PITCH HAS STARTED TO TALK. IT HAS A LOT TO SAY.
lorry: THAT SPUN A MILE!
DUST IS FLYING, SPINNERS' PARADISE!
THE PITCH HAS TURNED INTO A BEACH!
grog: IT'S TURNING, SPINNER ON.
IT'S SPINNING OUT OF THE ROUGH. BOWL INTO IT, DON'T OVERTHINK IT.
GET THE PART-TIMER ON AND ROLL THE DICE.

bunnings: POWERPLAY DONE.
lorry: POWERPLAY'S OVER!
FIELDERS BACK, THE GAPS HAVE PACKED UP AND LEFT!
grog: FIELD'S BACK.

bunnings: THE LIGHT IS FADING, AND SO, PERHAPS, IS THE BATTING.
THE SHADOWS ARE LENGTHENING. SO IS THE FIELD.

lorry.text: THE LIGHTS ARE ON AND THE BALL'S SWINGING EVEN MORE!
LIGHTS ON AND IT'S A DISCO OUT THERE!

grog: LIGHT'S CHANGED. BOWL THE QUICK GUY NOW WHILE IT'S HARD TO SEE.
CAPTAIN SHOULD BE LOOKING AT THE SKY, NOT THE FIELD.
BOWL A BOUNCER FIRST BALL AFTER THE CHANGE AND SAY HELLO.

bunnings: LAST OVER BEFORE {brk}.
ONE OVER TO SURVIVE BEFORE {brk}. EASIER SAID.
SURVIVE THIS OVER AND {brk} WILL FEEL LIKE A HOLIDAY.
lorry: ONE OVER TO {brk}!
ONE OVER TO SEE OFF BEFORE {brk}, CAN HE HANG ON?!
LAST OVER BEFORE {brk}, SOMEONE HIDE THE SNACKS!
grog: SEE OUT THE OVER.
LAST OVER BEFORE {brk}. DEFEND EVERYTHING, KEEP YOUR WICKET.

grog.text: NIGHTWATCHMAN? SEND IN THE TOUGHEST BLOKE YOU'VE GOT.
